lesson: The system is consistently attempting to front-run reversals against a dominant bearish trend, leading to premature entries during liquidity sweeps that fail to hold. The reliance on local market structure shifts (SMC) is being invalidated by the persistent overhead supply on higher timeframes.
adjustment: Implement a 'Trend Filter' rule: ignore all long setups unless the 4h timeframe confirms a break of market structure (BMS) to the upside, regardless of local 15m liquidity sweeps.
methodology_flag: Trust local SMC liquidity sweeps LESS when the 4h/Daily trend is in a clear distribution phase.
